meta.title: Contact Yaqeen Advisory: Book a Free Discovery Call
meta.description: Book a free 30-minute discovery call with Yaqeen Advisory. Tell us about your business in India, the UAE or Saudi Arabia and get a scoped proposal in 2 working days.

hero.heading: Book a free discovery call.
hero.text: Tell us about your business. We will reply within 1 working day to set up a 30-minute call.

formHeading: Tell us how we can help
consent: By sending this form you agree that we may use your details to reply to your enquiry. See our privacy policy for how we handle your information.

expect.title: Discovery call
expect.text: 30 minutes. We learn your business, registrations and what is hurting today.

expect.title: Scoped proposal
expect.text: Within 2 working days. Your plan, add-ons and fee, in plain language.

expect.title: Onboarding
expect.text: Live in one week. Your first MIS arrives at your first month-end close.

faqs.a: Yes. The 30-minute discovery call is free and carries no obligation.

faqs.q: Which time zones do you work in?
faqs.a: We work with clients in India and the Gulf, and plan calls around Indian Standard Time, Gulf Standard Time and Arabia Standard Time working hours.
